meaning:
ἐν-δώμησις (Rec. -δόμησις), -εως, ἡ
(δωμάω, to build),
a build­ing in: ἡ ἐ. τ. τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, its wall had jasper built into it, Rev.21:18 (see MM, Exp., xiii; Swete, Ap., l.with).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.
